entries.0bb4b7e377e294fa: Net loss for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥780 million.
entries.138b07861d243d89: Revenue is derived from sales proceeds of Steboronin®. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥323 million, a decrease of 66.4% from the previous fiscal year, reflecting, among other factors, the absence in the current year of overseas sales recorded in the previous fiscal year.
entries.3022492396366452: The company has concluded an exclusive-period basic transaction agreement with Stella Chemifa, which has the technology to enrich the raw material boron isotope B-10 to high purity, and has a structure that allows stable procurement of raw materials. Steboronin® is a product approved as a subject of the Sakigake designation system, and multiple patents relating to its formulation have also been obtained.
entries.388db5952b429810: This is a single-segment business that develops, manufactures and sells Stebolonin®, a boron drug (generic name: borofalan (10B)) used in BNCT (boron neutron capture therapy), a radiation therapy that selectively destroys cancer cells. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥323 million. The head office (Chuo-ku, Osaka) is disclosed as an office, and the research laboratory (Naka-ku, Sakai) is disclosed as research and development facilities.
entries.48da46a925458baf: The business strategy in the Business Overview describes R&D and clinical trials aimed at expanding indications, expansion of the development pipeline, and a business approach aimed at raising awareness of BNCT and promoting the spread of accelerators.
entries.4e24d22316365f9e: This is a single-segment business that develops, manufactures and sells Stebolonin®, a boron drug (generic name: borofalan (10B)) used in BNCT (boron neutron capture therapy), a radiation therapy that selectively destroys cancer cells.
entries.509fa325a7e017d2: Revenue is the sales proceeds of pharmaceutical products.
entries.5dbb89676e0d95c0: The Business Overview states that Stella Chemifa is the only company in Japan with technology to enrich B-10 to high purity (99% or more); that the company has concluded an exclusive-period basic transaction agreement with Stella Chemifa; that it holds multiple patents relating to formulation; and that it has obtained manufacturing and marketing approval for a product subject to the Sakigake designation system.
entries.5fbe97e1ffb459eb: Medical institutions that provide BNCT treatment
entries.61d84927f85b869e: Steboronin® Intravenous Infusion Bag 9000mg/300mL (boron agent for BNCT; generic name: borofalan (10B); development code: SPM-011)
entries.6a855b522be920fd: The core of its strategy is expanding indications beyond the approved head and neck cancer indication, and increasing the number of cases in line with the spread of medical facilities providing treatment.
entries.7287b26b7b41b5fa: The company develops, manufactures and sells Steboronin®, a boron agent used in BNCT (boron neutron capture therapy), a radiation therapy that selectively destroys cancer cells. It has obtained approval for head and neck cancer and is also advancing clinical trials aimed at expanding indications to recurrent malignant glioma and angiosarcoma, among others.
entries.83459d101cc0a43c: Together with accelerator manufacturers, the company will conduct R&D and clinical trials aimed at expanding Steboronin®'s indications and continue to expand its development pipeline. In Japan, the company aims to raise awareness of BNCT and promote the spread of accelerators; overseas, it aims to obtain approvals mainly in the United States, Europe and Asia, and is planning an alliance model through collaboration with pharmaceutical companies and others.
entries.91f6715c80b9b84d: The Business Overview states that in March 2020 it obtained the world's first pharmaceutical manufacturing and marketing approval as a boron agent for BNCT, and that BNCT treatment is being performed at two medical institutions with accelerators installed: Sōgō Minami-Tōhoku Hospital and Osaka Medical and Pharmaceutical University Hospital.
entries.b51913d9b801918d: Customers are medical institutions that provide BNCT treatment, and the company sells through pharmaceutical wholesalers. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the sales destination was Esu Di Korabo Co., Ltd.
entries.bf06640f7eaac1a3: A company that develops, manufactures and sells Steboronine®, a boron drug used in BNCT (boron neutron capture therapy), a cancer treatment.
entries.c3c8dfe5a6871cfe: Steboronin® is the world's first product to obtain pharmaceutical manufacturing and marketing approval as a boron agent for BNCT. BNCT treatment is performed at two medical institutions in Japan: Sōgō Minami-Tōhoku Hospital and Osaka Medical and Pharmaceutical University Hospital.
entries.dc3c4c857188ce9c: It is a business model that manufactures Suteboronin®, a boron drug for BNCT, and earns revenue by selling it through pharmaceutical wholesalers to medical institutions that provide BNCT treatment.
entries.e010e96d202858a7: Medical institutions providing BNCT treatment (via pharmaceutical wholesalers)
entries.f8fd27e805b51ae4: The company was established in June 2007 as a wholly owned (100%) subsidiary of Stella Chemifa Corporation, and its head office is in Chuo Ward, Osaka City. It has a research and development base, the Sakai Sōyaku Kenkyū Center, in Naka Ward, Sakai City, and as of March 31, 2026, the number of employees was 47.
